jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Enterprise
jobs.description:
**Dealpath is looking for a self-motivated Customer Success Manager to join our growing team in New York City or San Francisco!**

As a Senior CSM at Dealpath, you'll own a portfolio of enterprise and strategic accounts, typically 30 to 40, for firms like Blackstone, MetLife, and Nuveen. Your customers are investment professionals and executive stakeholders who rely on Dealpath to run how they deploy capital. You'll take on the most complex accounts, mentor other CSMs, and help shape how the team operates.

### **You're excited about this opportunity because you'll:**

* **Manage a book of business:** 30-40 enterprise accounts as the primary relationship holder for investment teams and C-suite stakeholders.
* **Drive adoption and value:** Define success criteria early and make sure every customer can articulate what Dealpath is doing for their business.
* **Lead QBRs and EBRs:** Data-driven business reviews that keep customers aligned and build the case for renewal.
* **Lead renewals end to end:** Build the case well before the contract date, not at the finish line.
* **Identify and grow upsell opportunities:** Grounded in a deep understanding of each customer's investment strategy.
* **Be the voice of your customers internally:** Synthesize feedback to product, engineering, and sales.
* **Develop genuine CRE expertise:** Advise customers on configuring Dealpath to their workflows and become a trusted subject matter expert.
* **Stay close to our AI roadmap:** Our customers are actively asking about AI and our CSMs are on the front lines of how it lands.

### **Qualifications:**

* **1.5+ years** as a CSM or Client Success Manager at a B2B SaaS company, direct account ownership, not a team management role
* **Proven renewal and upsell experience**, end to end, not supporting someone else's process
* **Enterprise account experience**, multi-year contracts and executive-level stakeholders
* **QBR/EBR experience**, comfortable leading data-driven business reviews
* **Clear, polished communicator**, skilled at building credibility with C-suite stakeholders including CIOs and Heads of Acquisitions
* **Excel/Google Sheets proficiency**, you'll use it regularly
* **Curiosity about AI**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

### **Nice to Have:**

* Experience in CRE tech, proptech, or adjacent financial technology (alternative investment platforms, private capital software)
* Background supporting a complex, configurable SaaS product requiring deep domain expertise
* Familiarity with the CRE acquisition process
* Salesforce experience

**The Perks & Culture:**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* Health Savings Account (HSA) & Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options.
* 401(k) retirement plan.
* Paid Parental Leave.
* Flexible Time Off (FTO) policy.
* Commuter benefits program.
* Monthly wellness reimbursement to support physical and mental well-being.
* Hybrid Work Policy, 3 days in office (Tues/Wed/Thur).
* The estimated pay range for New York City, New York candidates is $110,000-$115,000 + equity. Eligible for variable incentive compensation with a target incentive equal to 20% of OTE. OTE range: $137,500-$150,000.
* Your compensation will be based upon several factors including your experience, qualifications, education, location, and the skills assessed in Dealpath's interview process. Your actual compensation will be confirmed in writing at the time of offer.
* Dealpath's compensation ranges are determined by current market data, so compensation data posted on our job posts may change as new market data becomes available.
* Interviews may include AI-assisted note-taking tools in accordance with applicable privacy requirements.

**About Dealpath**:

Dealpath is the world's largest and most trusted AI-powered operating system for real estate investing. To date, the platform has powered more than $10 trillion in transactions, partnering with hundreds of firms, including leading global institutions such as Blackstone, Nuveen, LaSalle, CBRE IM, MetLife, Newmark, New York Life, UBS, Manulife, DWS, and Principal.  
  
By bringing together the only private exchange for institutional real estate listings, investment data, and intelligent execution workflows into a single platform, Dealpath enables firms to capture more opportunities, make faster decisions, execute efficiently, and deliver superior returns.  
  
Our company is led by an experienced team and backed by a combination of top tier venture capital firms and strategic industry partners including: Blackstone, Nasdaq, 8VC, JLL Spark, WTI, GreenSoil Investments, LeFrak, Milstein, Bechtel, and Morgan Stanley Expansion Capital.  
  
We value your voice! If you get excited about solving real business challenges and working closely with other smart folks in a winning culture — we'd love to meet you!

**Interview Process Notice**

Dealpath conducts interviews via video conference. To support our interviewers with accurate note-taking, we may use AI-assisted transcription tools during your interview sessions. By participating in the interview process, you acknowledge that interviews may be recorded or transcribed using these tools for note-taking purposes only. Transcripts are used solely for internal evaluation and are not shared outside of the hiring team.

jobs.title: Senior Clinical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

**The Opportunity:**

This is a unique opportunity for a Clinical Operations Professional. As a Sr. Clinical Program Manager, you will be responsible for acting as a central contact for the Clinical Study Team(s) and assist with the execution and management of Revolution Medicines (RevMed) clinical trials.

Responsibilities:

* Adhere to Clinical Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) Guidelines.
* Be a team leader, providing guidance and oversight for the successful management of all aspects of clinical trials within timelines and designated program budgets.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to manage, adjust, and revise project timelines and budgets as needed
* Analyze data health metrics to be shared with stakeholders.
* Actively partner with cross-functional teams and vendors to drive the query resolution and data listings review process to meet objectives in a timely and efficient process.
* Conduct risk management, contingency, and scenario planning.
* Supervise, communicate project status/issues, and problem solve to ensure project team goals are met.
* Participate in the development of all study-related documentation, including study protocols.
* Actively contribute in the selection and management of contract research organizations (CROs) and/or vendors, including development of requests for proposals (RFPs).
* Use all available tools to track, oversee, and communicate on program status to all key stakeholders.
* Demonstrate the ability to lead and manage multiple complex clinical trials within one or multiple programs with limited oversight.
* Independently lead Clinical Study Execution Team (CSETs) and influence relevant stakeholders both internally and externally including management.
* May lead interdepartmental strategic business initiatives as well as spearhead certain SOP development and training.
* May provide input into strategic and operational short- and long-term therapeutic area development, as appropriate, including supporting alignment and communication to other team members upon implementation
* Assists in the hiring, development, and retention of top talent within the team. Coach direct report(s) on their performance, development, and career interests.
* Participate in other Clinical Operations activities as appropriate.

**Required Skills, Experience and Education:**

* RN or Bachelor’s or Masters degree in biological sciences or health-related field required.
* 10+ years direct Clinical Operations experience in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry, preferably in Clinical Operations or Clinical Research-related experience. Relevant indirect experiences may also meet the requirement.
* Minimum of 6 years of cross-functional study management or related leadership experience in life sciences, including multiple years’ experience managing project teams.
* Experience in Oncology Trials
* Strong working knowledge of FDA Regulations, ICH Guidelines, and GCP.
* Proven ability to successfully start-up, manage, and close-out clinical trials, including authoring clinical study and regulatory documentation and SOPs.
* Experience in selection of CROs/vendors and management of external resources.
* Thrives in a collaborative team setting that demonstrates flexibility required to maintain a fast pace and is driven by a desire to deploy innovative approaches and technologies in a high-energy environment.

* Be solution-oriented by anticipating obstacles and difficulties, and proactively providing risk assessment and mitigation strategies to achieve project goals.

* Excellent written/verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* High sense of priority and commitment to excellence in the successful execution of deliverables.
* Ability to analyze operational data, contribute with a mind on quality, timeliness and fiscal responsibility, make and drive decisions, multi-task, prioritize tasks, anticipate challenges, and execute on goals as a member of an interdisciplinary team.
* Demonstrate proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint); MS Project and/or Smartsheet a plus.
* Travel may be required (~25%).

**Preferred Skills:**

* Familiarity working with vendor systems/portals (e.g., eTMF, EDC, IRT, CTMS).
* Oncology experience, early and/or late stage, strongly preferred.
* Knowledge and/or familiarity with Ex-US region(s) clinical trial operations.
* Some experience managing direct reports.

The **Patient Care Coordinator** functions as an integral member of the team and is the first point of contact for all people inquiring about the provider's practice. The primary role is to organize the practice's daily activities and paperwork.

This position is full time. Employees are required to work Monday - Friday 8:30am to 5:00pm including weekends/holidays and OT as needed based on business need. We offer job training.

* Proactively identifies and lead department process improvement opportunities

**Required Qualifications:**

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). jobs.title: Plumbing Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Plumbing Project Manager:**

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Plumbing Project Manager to oversee the planning, execution, and completion of our Plumbing Division. We service multi-family homes, handling repairs, replacements, and more. This role involves coordinating with clients, managing budgets, ensuring compliance with safety regulations, and working closely with technicians, contractors, and other stakeholders. We value dedicated team members who are readily available to address urgent situations and support our field teams, ensuring smooth operations for our clients. The ideal candidate will have strong leadership abilities, technical expertise, and a results-driven mindset.

**What You'll Do:**

* Oversee and manage Plumbing projects from inception to completion, ensuring on-time and within-budget delivery.
* Develop project schedules, allocate resources, and coordinate with clients, contractors, and vendors.
* Review project plans, specifications, and contracts to ensure compliance with industry standards and company policies.
* Lead site visits, inspections, and progress meetings to monitor project status and address any issues.
* Work closely with technicians and subcontractors to optimize performance and efficiency.
* Ensure compliance with safety standards, local codes, and regulations.
* Prepare and manage project budgets, including cost estimates, bids, and invoices.
* Maintain accurate documentation, reports, and project records.
* Communicate effectively with clients to understand their needs and ensure customer satisfaction.

**What You Bring to the Table:**

* Must have a minimum of 3+ years proven experience in Plumbing
* Must have a minimum of 2+ years proven experience as a Project Manager
* Familiarity with **building codes, regulations, and safety standards**.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in project management software and Google Office Suite.
* Ability to read and interpret blueprints, schematics, and technical documents.
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel to project sites as needed.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary ($90,000 – $105,000 per year) based on experience.
* Performance-based bonuses
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Paid time off and holidays

**Why Gallaher Co?**

We've experienced rapid growth over the past decade, tripling in size and expanding our services. We're a solid company with a strong foundation and a clear vision for the future. We're looking for talented individuals to join our team and help us reach our ambitious growth goals. We're a fast-paced, family-like company with a casual work environment. While we're still developing formal career development programs, we offer a unique opportunity to directly contribute to our growth and shape our future. We are driven by our mission “empowering our communities to thrive” and are looking for like minded individuals. If you're looking for a company where you can make a real impact and grow alongside us, we encourage you to apply.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Applications will not be considered without a current Resume.

jobs.title: User Conversion & Operations Specialist
jobs.description:

**About Think Academy**

We are looking for a **User Conversion & Operations Specialist** who can develop a deep understanding of the needs of U.S. K–12 families and drive business growth through parent engagement, course conversion, and user operations.

This role will initially focus on **frontline parent communication and course conversion**. We are looking for someone who can do more than simply follow an established process. We want someone who **understands users, takes ownership of goals, and proactively finds ways to get results.**

  + Consistently follow up with prospective families and address common concerns related to learning outcomes, course difficulty, scheduling, pricing, and other considerations.
  + Take ownership of key conversion outcomes, including trial class bookings, attendance, and long-term course enrollment.
  + Identify recurring user needs, objections, and reasons for drop-off, and continuously improve communication strategies and conversion SOPs.

  + Track key metrics such as registration, participation, and conversion, and continuously optimize programs based on results.

* Bachelor's degree or above.

* Strong user communication skills, with the willingness to proactively reach out, follow up consistently, and move users toward the next step.
* Strong goal orientation and results ownership, with the ability to take responsibility for clear conversion and operational targets.
* Strong learning ability and execution skills; able to proactively identify solutions and move projects forward in ambiguous situations.

jobs.title: Clinical Quality Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Eikon Therapeutics is a new biopharmaceutical company employing revolutionary technology at the intersection of chemistry, engineering, computation, and biology to discover novel treatments for life-threatening diseases. Eikon's discovery platform is built on groundbreaking innovations from its founders (Nobel Prize, 2014), culminating in the creation of microscopes which enable real time, molecular-resolution measurements of protein movement in living cells, thereby unlocking otherwise intractable classes of proteins as drug targets.

**Position**

In partnership with the Director of Process Management for Clinical Research & Development, to whom this role reports, the Clinical Quality Operations Manager (CQOM) is accountable for the execution of operational quality management and inspection readiness activities across assigned clinical programs within Eikon's clinical development portfolio. The CQOM oversees clinical quality operations across assigned clinical programs, embedding quality-by-design (QbD) principles, risk-based quality plans, and vendor oversight into Eikon's clinical trials. This includes ensuring consistent execution of QbD principles across assigned clinical studies, facilitating identification of Critical to Quality (CtQ) factors and associated risk assessments, and establishing and actively maintaining study-specific quality plans throughout the study lifecycle using a risk-based approach. The CQOM is accountable for maintaining inspection readiness through disciplined execution of risk assessments, quality plans, and operational standards, in collaboration with Clinical Quality Assurance (CQA) on inspection preparation, management and follow-up activities.The successful candidate will work closely with cross-functional Clinical Research & Development teams to ensure successful completion of studies within timelines and budget, with a focus on exquisite quality to support operational excellence and world-class in-house clinical study management.

This role requires onsite presence at minimum 3 days per week in our Millbrae, CA or Jersey City, NJ offices to support effective management, operational excellence, and high-performance delivery of clinical studies and expected team growth & collaboration.

**About You**

You are a collaborative, hands-on quality operations professional who enjoys working alongside clinical study teams to strengthen consistency, embed quality and drive disciplined trial execution. You bring credibility through deep knowledge of GCP and strong clinical operations expertise and are energized by cross-functional partnership. You are excited about the opportunity to help shape a new function in a growing organization.

**What You'll Do**

* Ensures consistent execution of 'quality by design' principles in assigned clinical trials. Reviews Risk Assessment and Categorization Tools (RACTs), quality plans, and study-specific procedures with Study Management Teams to confirm accuracy, compliance with Sponsor requirements, and inspection-readiness.
* Facilitates review of CtQs, quality plans and risk mitigation approaches to identify inconsistencies, emerging signals, and trends and to provide relevant feedback to the Head of Clinical Study Management and Director of Process Management for Clinical R&D, as appropriate.
* Works with Clinical R&D peers to analyze data across Eikon's clinical trials to identify signals and trends and translate findings into actionable process improvement strategies.
* In partnership with the Director of Process Management for Clinical R&D, the Head of Clinical Data Analytics and Reporting and the Head of Clinical Study Management, builds proficiency in leveraging technology and data to recognize and respond to new and emerging risks across assigned clinical programs, including how GCP applies to digital data management and novel trial technology.
* Partners with cross-functional study teams to ensure vendor and CRO performance is documented in vendor and CRO oversight plans and monitored against quality expectations, escalating compliance, or inspection-readiness risks to Clinical R&D functional area Heads, as necessary.
* Builds and enables effective working relationships with key stakeholders to ensure and maintain role clarity and business effectiveness. This will include ongoing partnership with Clinical Quality Assurance (CQA) and acting as the link between Clinical R&D functional areas, clinical study teams, enterprise business functions, and regional study management.
* Contributes to the standardization of Clinical Quality Operations procedures, tools, and templates to ensure consistency and seamless progression throughout the study lifecycle.

**Inspection Preparation and Management**

* Maintains current, working knowledge of global GCP inspection practices – including requirements from FDA, EMA, MHRA, and other established and emerging authorities – to effectively support GCP inspections worldwide. May serve as point of contact for a specific regulatory area (e.g., FDA, EMA, NMPA). Is responsible for monitoring, interpreting, and communicating relevant regulatory developments.
* Maintains current awareness of filing schedules, potential future inspections, and ongoing inspection preparation activities.
* Supports CQA in developing, updating, and maintaining GCP inspection procedures and guidelines within Clinical Development Operations and Clinical R&D functional areas.
* Contributes to the development and/or revision of Eikon policies, SOPs, and training materials.
* Ensures the operational foundation supports favorable inspection outcomes and that study teams execute consistently against study plans and operational standards.
* Partners with CQA to ensure the Clinical R&D functional areas are fully informed and prepared to support Regulatory Health Authority inspections led by CQA, worldwide.
* Escalates potentially significant compliance risks/impact to Clinical R&D functional area Heads, as necessary.

jobs.description:
**Title: Finance and Business Operations Manager Reporting to: COO**

**ABOUT ANELLO**

ANELLO is innovative hardware company serving both defense and commercial customers with advanced navigation technology based on silicon photonics technology based by over 50 patents. These highly technical products are manufactured through a combination of internal activities, suppliers, and contract manufacturers. The company also performs work under multiple government contracts. ANELLO is at series B stage, has strong growing revenue and operating as a profitable company.

ANELLO is seeking a experienced and hands-on **Finance &** **Business Operations Manager** to lead the company's accounting and finance function and serve as a strategic partner to the leadership team.

This is an individual contributor role with broad responsibility across accounting, financial operations, financial planning, forecasting, and strategic analysis. The successful candidate will work closely with external accounting firm to own the integrity and timeliness of the company's financial information. Through the creation of a wide variety of financial models, the successful candidate will help leadership understand the financial implications of business decisions and identify opportunities to improve profitability, cash utilization, and operational efficiency.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

*Financial Operations and External Vendor Oversight*

* Act as the primary corporate point-of-contact to manage an external CPA firm, driving accountability and ensuring highly accurate, timely monthly, quarterly, and year-end close process.
* Supervise and audit the external firm's execution of core transaction processing, including general ledger management, accounts payable/receivable cycles, payroll administration, bank reconciliations, and accruals.
* Partner with external tax advisors to coordinate all federal, state, and local compliance requirements, including sales/use tax tracking, annual corporate filings, R&D tax credits, and specialized corporate valuations (e.g., 409A).
* Continually refine internal data pipelines, financial procedures, and documentation to ensure seamless transfer of financial records between internal teams and the external accounting provider.

*Financial Modeling, Forecasting & Strategic Advisory*

* Revenue & Sales Forecasting: Develop dynamic, scenario-based forecasting models across the broader business to project sales pipelines, diverse revenue streams, product pricing sensitivities, and long-term growth velocity.
* Build, maintain, and continually optimize financial models analyzing manufacturing costs, bill of materials (BOM), supply chain logistics, inventory turnover, and cost of goods sold (COGS) to maximize margins.
* Translate intricate modeling data, variance analyses, and financial anomalies into executive summaries, presentations, and KPIs that directly assist leadership's decision-making.
* Run detailed sensitivity analyses and capital allocation models to forecast corporate cash runway, evaluate major operational expenditures (CapEx), and support strategic runway planning.

*Government Contracting & Compliance*

* Monitor and track contract costs, expenditures, and invoicing requirements associated with SBIR and other government contracts.
* Work closely with technical teams to monitor performance against government budgets and support external compliance reviews.

**DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's or advanced degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Accounting, or related field.
* 5+ years of finance and accounting experience, or experience in an Assistant Controller, Finance Manager, or similar FinOps role.
* Demonstrated experience owning monthly close and financial reporting.
* Experience in financial modeling, forecasting, and analytical skills.
* Advanced spreadsheet skills and ability to build financial models from underlying business assumptions.
* Ability to effectively engage with external accounting firms, tax advisors, and other financial service providers.
* Solid understanding of cash flow, working capital, budgeting, and financial planning.
* Ability to analyze complex business issues and communicate financial implications
* Strong attention to detail without losing sight of broader business objectives.
* Ability to operate independently and effectively in a small, fast-moving organization.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in a technology, hardware, engineering, manufacturing, or startup environment.
* Experience with contract manufacturers, suppliers, inventory, and product costing.
* Experience developing pricing, profitability, cost-benefit, and capital allocation analyses.
* Experience supporting fundraising, company valuation, due diligence, M&A, or other strategic transactions.
* CPA, MBA, CFA, or other relevant professional qualifications.
* Experience scaling finance processes in a growing company.

Additional:

* Due to US Gov contracts in place, successful candidates will be US Citizens or US Perm Residents.

jobs.title: Manager, Quality Assurance
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**
====================

Crystal Bio Solutions is seeking a hands-on Quality Assurance Manager to independently perform and manage day-to-day quality assurance activities at our GLP bioanalytical laboratory in Pleasanton, California. The role is responsible for study and facility audits, maintaining the GLP Master Schedule, hosting client audits, supporting FDA GLP inspections, and maintaining effective quality systems and inspection readiness. This is an on-site, execution-focused position with direct access to senior management; it does not require managing a team.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**GLP QA and Study Oversight**

* Independently conduct GLP QA inspections and audits of study protocols, critical study phases, raw data, and interim/final reports; document findings and verify timely resolution.
* Personally maintain the GLP Master Schedule and related QA tracking records; prepare and issue QA audit reports and Quality Assurance Statements, as applicable.
* Assess laboratory compliance with approved protocols, SOPs, FDA 21 CFR Part 58, and other applicable requirements; provide independent quality guidance to study personnel and management.

**Client Audits, FDA Inspections, and Facility Readiness**

* Serve as the primary on-site QA host for client and sponsor audits, including preparation, auditor interactions, document coordination, and follow-up responses.
* Participate directly in FDA GLP inspections, including inspection readiness activities, investigator interactions, document retrieval, and follow-up on observations.
* Plan and perform internal facility and quality-system inspections; maintain site inspection readiness and track resulting corrective actions.

**Quality Systems, Documentation, and Compliance**

* Perform hands-on management of deviations, investigations, CAPA, change controls, and associated records; evaluate quality risks and CAPA effectiveness.
* Create, review, revise, and control QA procedures, SOPs, audit logs, and quality records; administer assigned workflows in the electronic quality management system (eQMS).
* Provide QA oversight of laboratory equipment qualification, calibration, maintenance records, computerized system validation documentation, and data integrity practices.
* Coordinate risk-based supplier qualification and oversight activities, including document review, assessments, and supplier audits as applicable.

**Training and Collaboration**

* Deliver practical GLP training; advise laboratory teams on compliance questions and required corrective actions.
* Prepare regular QA status updates and escalate significant quality issues directly to management.
* Collaborate with laboratory operations and cross-site QA colleagues while retaining accountability for assigned on-site QA activities.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s degree in Biology, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related scientific discipline.
* Minimum 5 years of hands-on Quality Assurance experience in a GLP-regulated laboratory, including direct experience performing GLP study and facility QA activities.
* Strong practical knowledge of FDA 21 CFR Part 58 and GLP documentation and inspection requirements.
* Direct hands-on experience maintaining GLP Master Schedules, auditing study documentation/raw data/final reports, and issuing QA documentation.
* Demonstrated experience personally hosting client or sponsor audits as an on-site QA contact.
* Direct participation in FDA GLP inspections, including preparation, interactions with FDA investigators, and inspection follow-up.
* Experience working with deviations, CAPA, change control, SOPs, and controlled quality records.
* Ability and willingness to independently execute daily QA work in a lean laboratory environment; strong organization, communication, and judgment skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* GLP bioanalytical CRO experience supporting PK/TK, ADA, immunogenicity, biomarkers, or related studies.
* Experience acting as the lead QA representative during an FDA GLP inspection.
* Familiarity with eQMS, computerized laboratory systems, and electronic-records/data-integrity requirements.

**Compensation**
================

Actual compensation within the posted range will depend on relevant skills, qualifications, experience, and other job-related factors.

jobs.title: International Quality Lead
jobs.description:
### **The Position**

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Genentech / Roche!

**The Opportunity**
===================

Are you ready to shape the future of quality management in healthcare? As a Quality Lead within our Pharma Development Quality (PDQ) division, you will support the Roche/Genentech organisation by developing and delivering robust Quality Assurance strategies, audits, and conclusions across molecules in development, post-approval products, and global processes. You will act as a trusted partner, ensuring our operations maintain the highest standards of compliance while directly influencing how we bring innovative therapies to patients safely and efficiently.

In this dynamic role, you will apply a risk-based approach to Quality Assurance using our Critical to Quality (CtQ) framework. By generating actionable data and insights through audits, you will collaborate closely with international stakeholders and play a vital part in preparing for and supporting regulatory authority inspections. This is an exceptional opportunity to utilise your expertise in a truly global, agile matrix environment where your insights drive continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:

* **Drive Quality Strategies:** Support the execution of risk-based Quality Assurance strategies and conclusions in predominantly Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) as well Good Clinical Practice (GCP),using the Critical to Quality (CtQ) framework.
* **Lead Global Audits:** Plan, perform, and lead audits, grouping individual issues into systematic trends to provide valuable quality data that fulfils regulatory requirements.
* **Partner with Stakeholders:** Establish and maintain strong partnerships with business stakeholders, presenting audit observations and associated compliance risks clearly.
* **Support Inspections:** Play a key role in regulatory authority inspection preparation and management.
* **Advance PDQ Processes:** Participate actively in assigned departmental goals and initiatives, contributing directly to the continuous improvement of PDQ processes.
* **Maintain GxP Expertise:** Maintain deep awareness and expertise in global regulations (such as FDA, EU, and ICH guidance) across GCP, GVP, or Medical Device frameworks.

**Who You Are**
===============

You are a proactive, analytical quality professional who thrives on transforming complex data into clear, actionable solutions. You are an excellent communicator, highly skilled at collaborating across cultures and influencing stakeholders at various levels with or without formal authority. You look for opportunities to develop your skills within an international team and are passionate about continuous growth.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

* **Education:** A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a scientific or quality-related field, or equivalent combined experience.
* **Industry Experience:** Proven experience within the pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device industry, with solid knowledge of end-to-end product operationalisation.
* **GxP Knowledge:** Strong exposure to and understanding of global GxP regulations and quality roles, specifically within GCP, GVP, or IVD/MD frameworks.
* **Data & Digital Literacy:** Excellent digital capabilities, with a good understanding of audit management and analytical reporting tools to drive data-led solutions.
* **Critical Thinking:** Proven problem-solving, decision-making, and project management skills with the ability to navigate ambiguous information.

Location

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of South San Francisco, CA is $111,000 - $206,100. jobs.title: Clinical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

**The Opportunity:**

This is a unique opportunity for a Clinical Operations Professional. As a Clinical Program Manager (CPM), you will be responsible for acting as a central contact for the Clinical Study Team(s) and assist with the execution and management of Revolution Medicines (RevMed) clinical trials.

* Adhere to Clinical Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) Guideline.
* Be a team leader, providing guidance and oversight for the successful management of all aspects of clinical trials within timelines and designated program budgets.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to manage, adjust, and revise project timelines and budgets as needed
* Analyze data health metrics to be shared with stakeholders.
* Actively partner with cross-functional teams and vendors to drive the query resolution and data listings review process to meet objectives in a timely and efficient process.
* Conduct risk management, contingency, and scenario planning.
* Supervise, communicate project status/issues, and problem solve to ensure project team goals are met .
* Participate in the development of all study-related documentation, including study protocols.
* Actively contributes in the selection and management of contract research organizations (CROs) and/or vendors, including development of requests for proposals (RFPs).
* Use all available tools to track, oversee, and communicate on program status to all key stakeholders.
* Participate in other Clinical Operations activities as appropriate.
* Leads a larger, more complex trial with some oversight from senior members of Clinical Operations.
* With minimal support, lead cross-functional Clinical Study Execution Team (CSETs).
* Participate in and contribute to SOP development, implementation, and training.
* Support junior team members through mentorship.

**Required Skills, Experience and Education:**

* RN or Bachelor’s or Masters degree in biological sciences or health-related field required.
* 8+ years direct Clinical Operations experience in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry, preferably in Clinical Operations or Clinical Research-related experience. Relevant indirect experiences may also meet the requirement.
* Minimum of 4 years of cross-functional study management or related leadership experience in life sciences, including multiple years’ experience managing project teams.
* Strong working knowledge of FDA Regulations, ICH Guidelines, and GCP.
* Proven ability to successfully start-up, manage, and close-out clinical trials, including authoring clinical study and regulatory documentation and SOPs.
* Experience in selection of CROs/vendors and management of external resources.
* Thrives in a collaborative team setting that demonstrates flexibility required to maintain a fast pace and is driven by a desire to deploy innovative approaches and technologies in a high-energy environment.

* Be solution-oriented by anticipating obstacles and difficulties, and proactively providing risk assessment and mitigation strategies to achieve project goals.
* Excellent written/verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* High sense of priority and commitment to excellence in the successful execution of deliverables.
* Ability to analyze operational data, contribute with a mind on quality, timeliness and fiscal responsibility, make and drive decisions, multi-task, prioritize tasks, anticipate challenges, and execute on goals as a member of an interdisciplinary team.
* Demonstrate proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint); MS Project and/or Smartsheet a plus.

* Familiarity working with vendor systems/portals (e.g., eTMF, EDC, IRT, CTMS).

jobs.description:
**OUR COMPANY:**

EOS IT Solutions is a Global Technology and Logistics company, providing Collaboration and Business IT Support services to some of the world's largest industry leaders, delivering forward-thinking solutions based on multi-domain architecture. Customer satisfaction and commitment to superior quality of service are our top business priorities, along with investing in and supporting our partners and employees.

We are a true International IT provider and are proud to deliver our services through global simplicity with trusted transparency.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO:**

We are seeking an experienced and proactive **Data Center Field Operations Lead** to oversee our infrastructure engineering team. The ideal candidate will lead the installation, service, maintenance, repair, and alteration of low voltage category cabling, communications cabling, and other various low voltage cabling systems. This position requires a deep expertise in fiber optics and will involve strategic leadership in racking and stacking equipment in data centers, ensuring proper installation and physical connectivity. The role demands a commitment to delivering sustainable and repeatable solutions and processes with a continuous improvement mindset while adhering to production, safety, and quality standards.

* Develop and enforce Method of Procedure (MOP) and Change Method of Procedure (CMOP) guidelines.
* Manage work ticket systems and infrastructure interfaces, ensuring efficient project execution and infrastructure maintenance.
* Oversee documentation and validate port maps, while providing advanced troubleshooting support.
* Direct power distribution and cable management tasks within the infrastructure to optimize performance and safety.

jobs.description:
**About Us**
============

We're living through a fundamental shift in how people discover, evaluate, and purchase products. The next generation doesn't respond to traditional marketing - they build relationships with brands through authentic social interactions, seek recommendations from communities they trust, and expect personalized experiences that feel human, not corporate.

At Nectar Social, we're building the AI-native social operating system that enables this new era of commerce. We believe every social interaction should deepen the relationship between brands and their communities while creating genuine value for both sides.

Founded by ex-Meta product and engineering leaders, we've raised over $30M in total capital from investors including GV and True Ventures. We work with brands like Oura Health, Caraway, e.l.f. Cosmetics, Kosas, OLIPOP, and many more. We're building the future of social commerce - where community, conversation, and commerce converge.

**The Role**
------------

We're scaling our sales team fast, and we need someone to make every Account Executive ready to sell Nectar well from day one. You'll be our first Sales Enablement hire: a hands-on builder who creates the pitch, the collateral, and the certification process that gets reps customer-ready.

You'll partner closely with marketing to turn our product and customer stories into materials reps reach for in live deals. This is a hands-on IC role: you'll build the content, run the certifications, and sit in on calls yourself. You'll be the connective tissue between Sales, Marketing, Product, and RevOps — and the voice of the field back to the business.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Content and pitch library:** Build and maintain pitch decks, talk tracks, demo flows, battlecards, objection-handling guides, and case studies across buyer personas (social, marketing, and CX leaders at consumer brands). Keep them current as the product evolves.
* **Pitch certification:** Design and run a rigorous certification program — rubric, scoring, and follow-through for reps who don't pass. AEs certify on internal mock pitches before they get on customer calls.
* **Onboarding and** ***ramp*****:** Own the new-hire program for AEs as we grow the team, so every rep ramps quickly and consistently and references it well past their first month.
* **Coaching:** Sit in on calls, run call reviews and deal deep dives, and lead small-group workshops. Be the person reps come to when a deal is stuck.
* **Product and competitive readiness:** Translate launches, roadmap updates, and competitive moves into crisp seller briefs — keeping the team sharp without making them read documentation.
* **Measurement:** Partner with RevOps to track *ramp* time, win rate, pipeline progression, and content usage, and use the data to decide what to build next.
* **Cross-functional partnership:** Work with Sales leadership, Marketing, Product, and RevOps on messaging, process, and rollouts such as pricing and packaging updates.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Minimum 4 years in B2B SaaS, including 3+ years in Sales Enablement, Revenue Enablement, or Sales Readiness
* Experience at a company with a sales team of 50-100 — you've seen what enablement looks like at scale
* Have built or meaningfully rebuilt an enablement program yourself, not just maintained inherited content
* Experience designing onboarding, certification, or pitch-practice programs for AEs
* Strong communication and presentation skills; comfortable coaching reps and giving direct feedback
* Process-oriented and organized, with the ability to build systems from zero

**Bonus Qualifications**
------------------------

* Started your career in B2B sales (AE or SDR) or product marketing before moving into enablement
* Background in martech, social media, or AI/automation platforms
* Familiarity with selling to consumer brands (beauty, CPG, e-commerce, retail)
* Experience standing up enablement tools (e.g., Highspot, Seismic, Gong, Lessonly)
* Fluency with AI-native tools for building content and training

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive compensation and early equity
* Health, vision, and dental benefits + 401(k) match
* ClassPass membership for fitness and wellness classes
* $50/month mobile stipend for all employees, and $50/month internet stipend for remote employees

**For our Palo Alto Office:**

* Hybrid schedule: 4 days in office, plus 3 remote flex days per quarter (after your first 3 months)
* Free lunch in the heart of University Ave. in Palo Alto
* $1,000/month housing stipend for living near the office
* Fully paid for commuter benefits (train stipend or Palo Alto parking reimbursement)

Compensation Range: $160K - $200K

jobs.title: Clinical Data Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**Role Overview**

This role is the connective tissue between Biometrics and Data Engineering. It exists because clinical data has meaning that structure alone doesn’t carry: someone has to understand what the data represents clinically, what the standards require of it, and how it must therefore be modeled — and then make sure the engineering team builds systems that produce it correctly.

The SME owns that translation. They bring clinical data domain expertise and a solid working command of CDISC standards, and they use it to guide the design of data products that are clinically correct, standards-conformant, traceable, and ready to support analysis and an AI-ready data strategy.

**Working knowledge of CDISC, SDTM, and ADaM is mandatory** — specifically, at the level required to design systems and pipelines that enforce the standards, map source data into them, and extend them where the data demands it.

The CDISC Expertise This Role Requires

*This is worth being precise about, because it defines who fits.*

**What we need:** someone who can look at source data and design the system that gets it correctly into SDTM — mapping source to target domains, enforcing controlled terminology through validation rather than manual review, and extending or customizing domains where the data genuinely requires it. This is applied, systems-oriented CDISC expertise: knowing the standard well enough to build against it and to tell an engineering team what “conformant” actually means in code.

**What we don’t need:** someone to author the standards themselves. This role doesn’t define new controlled terminology, sit on standards bodies, or own submission deliverables. It consumes the published standards and makes sure our systems honor them.

***What This Person Actually Does***

**Owns the clinical meaning of the data.** Serves as the authority on what the data represents — how it’s collected, what the clinical workflows behind it imply, and what constraints that places on how it can be structured. This is the judgment that engineering teams cannot supply for themselves.

**Designs how the standards get enforced.** Specifies how source and EDC data maps into SDTM target domains, and how controlled terminology is validated in the pipeline rather than checked after the fact. Determines when data fits an existing domain, when supplemental qualifiers suffice, and when a domain needs to be extended or customized to represent the data honestly — then makes sure that logic is built consistently rather than reinvented per study.

**Translates in both directions.** Turns clinical and business needs into requirements, mapping specifications, and user stories engineering can act on — and explains technical constraints and trade-offs back to Biometrics stakeholders in terms they can decide on.

**Protects traceability.** Ensures an unbroken path from source data through SDTM to analysis, so any value can be explained and defended. In a regulated environment this isn’t documentation hygiene; it’s what makes the data defensible.

**Integrates the data that doesn’t arrive neatly.** Brings external sources — labs, PK, biomarkers, imaging, eCOA — into standardized structures, resolving the mismatches in keys, terminology, and timing these sources invariably introduce.

**Guides delivery without owning the build.** Works alongside data engineers and architects, supplying clinical and standards input, reviewing designs, and validating that what’s delivered means what it’s supposed to mean. Engineering owns the how; this role owns the what and the why.

**Closes the loop on adoption.** Supports validation and testing against real clinical scenarios rather than functional checks alone, and stays engaged until the people who asked for the data product are actually using it.

**Sets the direction.** Drives clinical data strategy by embedding CDISC standards, data domains, and governance into how data is built — the discipline that makes datasets trustworthy enough to be analytics- and AI-ready.

***What We’re Looking For***

* **Solid working knowledge of CDISC**, sufficient to design systems and pipelines that produce conformant data.
* **Demonstrated source-to-SDTM mapping**: the ability to take raw, EDC, or legacy clinical data and map it correctly into target SDTM domains.
* **Practical command of controlled terminology** — enough to design validation that enforces it systematically, not to author it.
* **Ability to extend or customize SDTM domains** where the data requires it, with the judgment to know when that’s warranted versus when existing domains or supplemental qualifiers are the right answer.
* **Working understanding of ADaM** and how analysis-ready data derives from SDTM, sufficient to guide design and preserve traceability.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant / Office Manager
jobs.description:
**About Fragment**
------------------

Fragment is the AI platform that autonomously streamlines procurement workflows end to end. Within a few months of launch, we signed Fortune 500 companies. Within a year of founding, our customers, all $1B+ revenue enterprises, continue to grow in number and are actively championing us to their networks, and our marketing and CAC to get here has been $0.

We work from our San Francisco office five days a week. Being in the room together is how we move blazingly fast at "Fragment Pace". You'll work with a team of passionate builders, sharp operators, and most importantly kind, thoughtful humans who are here to reimagine the systems underlying the movement of physical goods and build a generational company.

**The role**
------------

Our founders’ time is increasingly becoming scarce at Fragment. Your job is to protect it and multiply it, so our founders and leadership team can efficiently prioritize the allocation of energy – to customers, product, and hiring exceptional people.

This role is about 70% executive support and 30% office and operations, and you'll directly support both founders. It's a high-trust seat: you'll have a view into nearly everything happening at the company, and real latitude to decide how we run. You'll also own the office and the moments that bring the team together as we scale.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Run the calendars of our founders: decide what gets time, resolve conflicts before they happen, and protect focus time. Relentless prioritization and optimization of their productivity.
* Coordinate with ops and drive preparation every day of agendas, briefing notes and materials, and follow through on action items so nothing drops.
* Plan travel end to end, from customer visits to last-minute trips, and rebook fast when plans change.
* Coordinate board and investor meetings, from scheduling and materials to logistics on the day.
* Run the office: facilities, vendors, supplies, meals and the hundred small things that make it a place people want to be.
* Plan team events, offsites and rituals that strengthen our culture as we grow.
* Build systems for all of it. We'd rather you automate a task once than do it by hand a hundred times.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 4+ years as an Executive Assistant, ideally supporting multiple executives at a high-growth startup.
* You've seen what world-class executive support looks like, and you hold yourself to that bar.
* You build rapport. You honor commitments and meet deadlines.
* You anticipate. You've booked the car, sent the pre-read, and flagged the conflict before anyone asks.
* Sharp judgment on priorities: you know when to say yes, when to push back and when to escalate.
* Discretion. You'll see board materials, compensation and sensitive conversations, and they stay with you.
* You write well and move fast; requests get handled the same day, not the next week
* Organized and proactive. You juggle many competing demands and share updates before anyone has to ask.
* Low ego. No task is too small when it helps the team, and you take pride in getting the details right.
* You hold yourself to an exceptionally high standard and cannot work any other way; this is just how you're wired.

Compensation Range: $150K - $200K

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Customer Support Specialist to manage key client accounts and act as the primary liaison between our customers and internal operations.

This is a senior individual contributor role that focuses on end-to-end account ownership, including order management, delivery tracking, customer invoicing, order escalations, and daily cross-departmental coordination. * **Order Adjustments:** Manage client requests for expedites, order modifications, reschedules, cancellations, and return material authorizations (RMAs).
* **Forecast & Demand Tracking:** Monitor customer demand forecasts and convey changing needs to internal production and planning teams.
* **Documentation & Portals:** Maintain updated customer accounts, interaction records, and supporting files; update customer-specific portals and reports as required.

Required:

Significant prior experience in customer service, account management, or order fulfillment within a manufacturing environment (or equivalent combination of education and experience).  

Solid understanding of manufacturing workflows, production cycles, material lead times, and scheduling dynamics.  
Hands-on experience processing customer purchase orders and navigating ERP/MRP software systems.  
Familiarity with billing routines, including invoice preparation and discrepancy resolution.  
Proficiency with Microsoft Office programs, particularly Microsoft Excel and Outlook.  
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interface across all levels of internal and external organizations.  
Excellent organizational skills, detail orientation, and multi-tasking abilities.  

Preferred:

Experience in contract manufacturing, precision sheet metal fabrication, machining, semiconductor, or electronics manufacturing.  

Background supporting Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) or high-value key accounts.  
Working knowledge of purchase orders, work orders, forecasts, RMAs, and web-based customer management portals.

**Job Overview**

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on **Marketing Operations Manager** to oversee the systems, processes, analytics, budgets, and resources that support our marketing efforts.

Reporting to the CMO, this role serves as the operational backbone of our marketing function, ensuring our technology, data, workflows, and internal and external resources work together efficiently and effectively.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical and analytical capabilities with excellent communication, project management, and marketing judgment. They understand the full marketing ecosystem, can distinguish strong creative and messaging from mediocre work, and know how to translate business objectives into well-executed marketing initiatives.

**Summary:**

The Delinea People Team is ramping up for our next phase of growth. We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Operations Manager to lead the transformation of our global talent acquisition infrastructure and drive operational excellence across our end to end hiring experience. This role will oversee all recruiting systems & tools, programs and processes, accelerating our hiring experience as we scale for growth.

You've been in a senior Talent Acquisition Operations role, and you've built or significantly scaled a function at a high-growth tech company. You know Ashby in depth. You've used AI in recruiting and have views on where it helps and where it doesn't.

You've led a small team and still like doing some of the work yourself. You like building from scratch. There's no playbook here yet, and you'll write it with the VP of Talent and the wider leadership team.

**What you'll do:**

**Process**

* Redesign our end-to-end recruiting process, focusing on operational rigor, data, automation and an excellent experience for candidates and hiring teams alike
* Build and document SOPs, SLAs and structured interviewing practices across all functions globally
* Partner with our People Analytics team to build recruiting metrics and reporting designed for consumption across our executive leadership team
* Partner with our Legal and People teams to ensure hiring practices are compliant across the global landscape

**Programs & Data**

* Own program strategy, structure and execution for all recruiting programs, including our Referral Program, Internal Mobility, Talent Marketing
* Create data driven reporting to measure recruiting capacity and recruiter effectiveness against KPIs
* Create data driven reporting to accurately give global leaders appropriate and digestible insight into the state of hiring for their organization
* Own job posting strategy and job description standards

**Systems & Tools**

* Manage all tools and systems used by the recruiting team, ensuring effective workflows and appropriate usage and operational health
* Be the subject matter expert for our ATS, Ashby, maintaining data integrity and consistent ATS usage across all users
* Evaluate and introduce new tools and AI-driven automation to reduce manual work and give recruiters more time with candidates and hiring teams

**Enablement**

* Provide regular enablement to the recruiting team on usage and changes to tools, processes and workflows, driving transformation as automation and efficiencies are realized
* In partnership with our Marketing team and in alignment with our brand, enable all recruiters to share the Delinea story to the external talent marketplace

**What you’ll bring:**

* 5+ years proven success in a recruiting or talent acquisition role, with 3+ years in a recruiting operations or recruiting programs role, ideally at a high growth tech or SaaS company
* Administrative experience with a modern ATS, Ashby strongly preferred (Greenhouse, Lever, or similar tools will be considered)
* A track record of building or redesigning recruiting processes and programs, such as referral program, internal mobility, candidate experience
* Strong aptitude with AI and automation
* Strong analytical skills, with experience building recruiting dashboards and using data to tell a story
* Proven project and change management skills, with the ability to scope work, align stakeholders, and land change in partnership with cross functional peers and leaders
* Experience partnering with People Operations, HRIS, and IT on integrations, data flows, and compliance
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable training and presenting to various audiences
* Global experience preferred

Turing is looking for candidates with strong experience in project planning, execution, and stakeholder coordination, particularly at the level expected for professional project managers leading cross-functional teams and complex technical or scientific initiatives.

**Role overview:**

* In this role, you will contribute to projects that help evaluate and enhance AI systems using your project management and organizational expertise.
* No prior AI experience is required.
* These projects will help you explore how AI can improve workflow planning, communication, and process automation across professional and technical environments.

* Design and solve real-world project management and coordination scenarios to test AI reasoning.

* Strong compensation (exact amount varies by project).
* Fully remote work environment.
* Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer, potentially full-time.

**What Turing is NOT seeking from your expertise:**

* Confidential or proprietary information from any employer, university, etc.
* Trade secrets or internal company or university data.
* Specific client information or case details.
* Any information that would violate NDAs, employment agreements or other confidentiality obligations.

**About Turing:**

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Senior Project Manager to lead and oversee complex infrastructure construction projects from inception to completion. In this pivotal role, you will coordinate multidisciplinary teams, manage project schedules, budgets, and resources, ensuring all work aligns with safety standards, regulatory requirements, and client expectations. Your leadership will drive project success, foster collaboration among stakeholders, and deliver high-quality results on time and within scope. This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated professional eager to make a significant impact in the construction industry.

* Lead the planning, execution, and closing of large-scale infrastructure projects, ensuring adherence to project schedules, budgets, and quality standards
* Develop comprehensive project plans utilizing project management software such as Primavera P6, Procore, Prolog, or equivalent tools
* Coordinate construction schedules and sequencing using construction scheduling techniques and software like Primavera or HeavyBid to optimize workflow
* Manage project teams by assigning tasks, providing guidance, and monitoring performance to ensure efficient project delivery
* Oversee construction estimating processes and cost management activities to maintain profitability and control expenses
* Review construction plans, schematics, blueprints, and regulatory documents such as contracts and permits for accuracy and compliance
* Ensure all work complies with construction regulations, safety standards, and environmental policies while maintaining documentation for audits and inspections
* Communicate effectively with clients, subcontractors, suppliers, and internal teams to facilitate smooth project coordination and resolve issues promptly

* Extensive knowledge of construction management software including ProCore, Bluebeam, Primavera P6, Prolog, Civil 3D, HeavyBid or similar tools
* Demonstrated expertise in construction scheduling, project coordination, cost management, and budget oversight
* Strong understanding of construction regulations, safety protocols, and regulatory compliance requirements
* Ability to read and interpret construction plans, schematics, blueprints, and technical drawings accurately
* Excellent leadership skills with experience managing teams in a construction management role
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) for reporting and documentation purposes

* Effective time management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment

We work with government, regulatory officials, and insurance companies to address issues that impact the T1D community - breaking through barriers that limit access to care worldwide. **THE OPPORTUNITY**

The Coordinator, Member Services and Communications position will be responsible for customer service, reporting, record keeping, social media, member communication, and other aspects of the organization. This role works closely to support the staff team and volunteers to effectively influence member retention and customer satisfaction. The Coordinator, Member Services and Communications will work with all necessary constituencies, both internal and external, with a focus of optimizing programming for the LPGA Foundation.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Serve as the first point of contact for LPGA Amateurs and LPGA\*USGA Girls Golf inquiries through email, phone and other support channels; answer routine questions and appropriately escalate program-specific or complex issues.

* Support registration, membership, benefits, renewals, Chapter leader, account questions and other member-service processes while identifying recurring issues and opportunities to improve the member journey.

* Assist parents, participants and Site Directors with membership questions, program information, benefits, registration and navigation of Girls Golf systems and resources.
* Assist members and Chapter Leaders with membership, benefits, renewals, chapter questions, events and navigation of LPGA Amateurs systems and resources.
* Coordinate and execute member-facing communications for LPGA Amateurs, including newsletters, program announcements, membership communications, website updates and targeted email campaigns.
* Support social media activities by drafting, scheduling, and posting engaging content across social media channels; monitor audience engagement and help ensure content is timely, accurate, and aligned with organizational priorities and brand guidelines.
* Maintain integrated communications calendars for both programs and work with program leaders to ensure communications are timely, coordinated and aligned with broader LPGA messaging.
* Maintain accurate member information, assist with member databases/CRM platforms and help identify trends in member questions, engagement and service needs
* Track common inquiries and service issues and recommend FAQs, automated communications, resources or process improvements that reduce friction for members and staff.
* Support the activation of member, chapter, and company partnerships/sponsorships as appropriate.
* Coordinate programs / campaigns related to member retention and member growth.
* Partner with Girls Golf, LPGA Amateurs, Marketing, Communications, IT and other LPGA teams to ensure members receive accurate and consistent information.

  

**WHO YOU ARE**

* Minimum of Associate’s Degree in Business Management, Communications or equivalent
* Minimum 3 years of experience in customer service or related experience
* Experience creating and managing social media content, with an understanding of platform best practices, audience engagement, and basic performance metrics
* Golf knowledge preferred
* Excellent interpersonal and written/verbal communications skills
* Strong technical skills including proficient knowledge in the MS Office suite, Google suite, database management and basic social media platforms
* Familiarity with the structure and operations of Association Chapters is helpful
* Excellent organization, time management, and creative problem-solving skills are a must
* A customer-service oriented mindset
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously while maintaining a strong attention to detail

The **Ladies Professional Golf Association (LPGA)** is the world’s premier women’s professional golf organization. Created in 1950 by 13 pioneering female Founders, the LPGA, whose members now represent nearly 40 countries, is the longest-standing professional women’s sports organization. Through the LPGA Tour, the Epson Tour, the LPGA Professionals, and a joint venture with the Ladies European Tour, the LPGA provides female professionals the opportunity to pursue their dreams in the game of golf at the highest level. In addition to its professional tours and teaching accreditation programs, the LPGA features a fully integrated Foundation, which provides best-in-class programming for female golfers through its junior golf programming, and its LPGA Amateurs division, which offers its members playing and learning opportunities around the world.

jobs.description:
For more than 100 years, Modine has solved the toughest thermal management challenges for mission-critical applications. Our purpose of Engineering a Cleaner, Healthier World™ means we are always evolving our portfolio of technologies to provide the latest heating, cooling, and ventilation solutions. Through the hard work of more than 11,000 employees worldwide, our Climate Solutions and Performance Technologies segments advance our purpose with systems that improve air quality, reduce energy and water consumption, lower harmful emissions, enable cleaner running vehicles, and use environmentally friendly refrigerants. Modine is a global company headquartered in Racine, Wisconsin (U.S.), with operations in North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. For more information about Modine, visit modine.com.

**Position Description**
------------------------

At Modine, we are Engineering a Cleaner, Healthier World™. For more than 100 years, Modine has delivered innovative thermal management solutions that power critical industries worldwide. As demand for high-performance cooling solutions continues to accelerate, successful product development and launch execution are essential to ensuring customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and long-term product reliabiliy.

The Senior Quality Manager - New Product Introduction (NPI) is responsible for leading all quality planning and quality engineering activities associated with new product development and launch programs. This position serves as the primary Quality representative within cross-functional product development teams and is accountable for ensuring quality requirements, risks, and deliverables are effectively managed throughout Modine's stage-gate product development process.

The role provides independent assessment of product, process, supplier, and manufacturing readiness while ensuring quality considerations are appropriately represented during development reviews and launch decision-making. Through proactive risk identification, structured quality planning, and cross-functional collaboration, the Senior Quality Manager helps ensure products are launched on time, with robust manufacturing processes, capable suppliers, and exceptional customer quality performance

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**NPI Quality Leadership & Stage-Gate Governance**

* Serve as the primary quality representative for assigned New Product Introduction programs.
* Lead all quality planning and quality engineering deliverables throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Ensure completion of required quality activities and deliverables at each stage-gate milestone.
* Assess product, process, supplier, and customer quality risks and communicate readiness status during gate reviews.
* Provide independent quality recommendations regarding progression through development and launch phases.
* Drive accountability and closure of quality-related open items prior to launch approval.

**Design Quality & Risk Management**

* Participate as an embedded member of product development teams, representing the voice of quality throughout design and development activities.
* Facilitate Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA), Design Risk Reviews, Critical-to-Quality (CTQ) development, and Design for Quality (DFQ) activities.
* Ensure historical quality lessons learned, warranty data, and field performance feedback are incorporated into product designs.
* Partner with Engineering to identify and mitigate design risks early in development.
* Support development and execution of Design Verification Plans and Reports (DVP&R) and validation strategies.

**Manufacturing Readiness & Process Quality**

* Partner with Manufacturing Engineering and Plant Quality teams to ensure production processes are capable and launch-ready.
* Lead or facilitate Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA), Process Flow Diagrams, Control Plans, and process validation activities.
* Ensure quality requirements are incorporated into manufacturing processes, inspection plans, and production documentation.
* Support manufacturing readiness reviews and launch preparedness assessments.
* Coordinate quality activities associated with prototype, pilot, and production builds.

**Prototype, Pilot & Launch Support**

* Provide hands-on quality support during engineering builds, prototype builds, pilot builds, and production launch activities.
* Monitor build quality performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Lead investigation of build issues, nonconformances, and launch-related concerns.
* Ensure corrective actions are implemented and validated prior to production release.
* Support transition of products into normal production and operational ownership.

**Quality Metrics, Reporting & Readiness Reviews**

* Develop and maintain NPI quality scorecards and launch readiness metrics.
* Track quality risks, open issues, corrective actions, validation status, supplier readiness, and manufacturing readiness.
* Present quality status, recommendations, and risk assessments during program and leadership reviews.
* Provide clear visibility of launch risks and mitigation plans.

**Required Education & Qualifications**
---------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in Quality Engineering, Product Development, Manufacturing Engineering, Program Management, or related technical disciplines.

* DFMEA
