new_jobs.title: Partner Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

A small number of Apollo's partners account for the majority of partner-driven revenue — and how well Apollo manages those relationships has an outsized effect on the business. Apollo has thousands of partners who've raised their hand, and a named-partner motion that's still being built to actually activate and grow the best of them into that tier. As Partner Account Manager (PAM), you'll own a focused, named book of Apollo's highest-value partners (roughly 20–30) once they've proven sustained activity and strategic importance.

That's what makes this such an exciting moment to join: you're not inheriting a mature program, you're helping define what high-touch partner management looks like at Apollo. We're looking for someone with a genuine builder mentality who wants a real hand in shaping the program's future, not just running an existing playbook.

Apollo's ambition goes beyond any single integration or referral channel — we want our partner program to be at the heart of the revolution GTM AI is bringing to outbound sales. Agencies of every kind are core to that, and you're the one turning it into durable growth for our most important partners.

This isn't a maintenance role — it's a growth lever. You'll build joint business plans with each partner, run the operating cadence that keeps both sides accountable, grow managed ARR and customer outcomes alongside Sales, Customer Success, and RevOps, and make the call on when a partner is ready to progress, needs support, or should step back from named coverage.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Own the Named Partner Book**

* Maintain a live account plan for every partner in your book — segment, tier, health status, IPP score, and next milestone
* Flag at-risk accounts before they become escalations
* Serve as the system of record for who's in the book and why

**Build Joint Business Plans**

* Co-create mutual goals with each partner: target segments, pipeline objectives, managed-customer growth targets
* Build certification and enablement plans directly into the joint business plan, not as a side conversation
* Set the co-marketing and executive-alignment agenda for the period

**Grow Managed ARR and Customer Outcomes**

* Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and RevOps to find expansion opportunities inside partner-managed accounts
* Monitor adoption and usage signals closely enough to catch churn or delivery risk before it shows up in retention
* Bring data — not anecdotes — to internal reviews of what's working across the managed book

**Run the Operating Cadence**

* Run regular 1:1 check-ins and formal Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with every named partner
* For top-tier partners, lead a deeper annual strategic review with a standing recommendation prepared in advance
* Come to every touchpoint with the latest scorecard pulled and open items tracked

**Maintain Standing and Progression**

* Track certification coverage, customer quality, and routing eligibility on an ongoing basis, not just at review time
* Build promotion, remediation, or downgrade recommendations on consistent criteria, not gut feel
* Own accountability internally whenever a partner's standing is in question

### **Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in partner/channel account management, customer success, or strategic account management, ideally in B2B SaaS
* Demonstrated success managing a portfolio of external relationships against mutual growth goals (joint business plans, QBRs, or equivalent)
* Comfortable owning revenue-adjacent outcomes (managed ARR, NRR, retention) in partnership with Sales, CS, and RevOps
* Strong executive presence — able to run a quarterly business review and represent Apollo credibly to partner leadership
* Organized and data-driven, with experience maintaining account plans, scorecards, and health tracking across a named book

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working within the HubSpot or Salesforce agency/partner ecosystems
* Experience managing a tiered partner book (e.g., strategic/named tiers with differentiated cadence and service levels)
* Familiarity with partner/channel platforms (PartnerStack, Crossbeam, or similar)
* Background working alongside Partner Marketing on co-marketing, case studies, or joint events
* Experience in a GTM, sales-engagement, or RevOps ecosystem

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonus target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Apollo and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. **Implementation Specialist**

If you’ve ever been to a library and checked out a book or placed a hold online, you may have used our software. The Library Corporation (TLC) has been servicing the Library Industry since 1974. TLC provides premier automation, cataloging, and data services to more than 4,500 public, school, academic, and special libraries worldwide, ranging from single-site facilities to massive metropolitan systems.

The Library Corporation is looking for an Implementation Specialist responsible for managing data migration, transformation, and configuration, facilitating the implementation of TLC software and interfaces. Identifies interface requirements and completes data mapping, testing, and validation.

The ideal candidate has excellent written and oral communication skills, is comfortable in a fast-paced and change-oriented environment, and knowledge of library operations is helpful.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Analyze customer data and requirements to deliver customized solutions to library customers
* Write programming specifications for manipulation of MARC, item, borrower, and transaction data for conversion
* Provide customized documentation to assist the library in implementing and maintaining the library database
* Creating customized project timelines and working with internal and external stakeholders to identify risks that affect project completion

**Qualifications and Skills**

* Strong customer service skills
* MARC proficiency and familiarity with library workflows
* Familiarity with command-line utility execution
* Attention to detail and good problem-solving skills individually and in a team environment.
* Active listening skills and the ability to critically evaluate problems
* Ability to learn quickly and apply that knowledge to various situations
* Identify areas of improvement to the process and product based on experience and customer feedback

**Benefits**  
TLC offers its employees opportunities to grow and make a real contribution. Our benefits package includes:

* Paid time off
* Health Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Dental Insurance
* Life Insurance
* 401(k)
* Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Dependent Care Account (DCA)
* Health Savings Account (HSA)

The salary range for this position is $40,000 – $55,000, commensurate with experience.

This position is open to remote candidates, although preference may be given to local candidates. No ongoing business travel requirement is anticipated for this position. Teleworkers may request to work +/- up to 2 hrs of deviation from the core hours for your daily schedule, subject to approval. Your core working hours must be consistent, totaling 40 hours per week, and not deviate without approval from your supervisor.

We are an equal opportunity employer offering competitive salaries and benefits and a congenial work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. new_jobs.title: Customer Support & Scheduling Specialist
new_jobs.description:
Prado’s Plumbing, Heating & Air is seeking a professional, customer-focused, and highly organized Remote Customer Support & Scheduling Specialist to support our daily operations and deliver an exceptional customer experience.

This position plays an important role in coordinating service appointments, responding to customer inquiries, maintaining accurate records, and communicating with our service teams. The ideal candidate is dependable, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities while maintaining a courteous and professional approach.

We welcome candidates with backgrounds in customer service, scheduling, administration, hospitality, or call center operations. Plumbing and HVAC industry experience is not required, as training can be provided to qualified candidates.

 **Compensation:**

$18 - $24 hourly

 **Responsibilities:**

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Respond to incoming telephone calls, emails, and customer inquiries in a timely and professional manner.
* Schedule, confirm, and update service appointments.
* Coordinate appointment availability with technicians and dispatch personnel.
* Maintain accurate customer records and appointment information within company systems.
* Communicate scheduling updates, service information, and follow-up details to customers.
* Assist with appointment changes, cancellations, and routine customer concerns.
* Direct technical questions and service issues to the appropriate team members.
* Maintain confidentiality when handling customer information.
* Support administrative tasks and contribute to efficient daily operations.
* Represent Prado’s Plumbing, Heating & Air with professionalism and a commitment to customer satisfaction.

 **Qualifications:**

**Qualifications & Skills**
---------------------------

Required qualifications:

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Basic computer proficiency and the ability to learn scheduling software.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
* Professional telephone etiquette and customer service skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with a remote team.
* Reliable internet access and a suitable home-office environment.

Preferred qualifications:

* Previous experience in customer service, scheduling, dispatch, reception, or administrative support.
* Familiarity with customer relationship management (CRM) systems.
* Experience handling high volumes of calls or customer requests.

Equivalent experience and transferable skills are welcome. Industry-specific experience is not required.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

Proposed compensation: $18–$24 per hour, depending on experience, qualifications, and the approved compensation structure.

Potential benefits, subject to company confirmation, include:

* Paid training and onboarding.
* Paid time off and company holidays.
* Health, dental, and vision insurance options.
* Retirement savings plan.
* Professional development and advancement opportunities.
* Remote work arrangement, subject to company policy.

 **About Company**

At Prado’s Plumbing, Heating & Air, we believe great service starts with great people. Our mission is to provide dependable plumbing, heating, and air-conditioning services while treating every customer with honesty, respect, and care. We take pride in doing the job right and creating lasting relationships with the families we serve.

Our vision is to build a company where customers know they can count on us and employees can build careers they’re proud of. We invest in our team through training, teamwork, professional development, and opportunities for advancement.

Our values are Integrity, Quality, Customer Care, Teamwork, Professionalism, and Growth. We believe in honest recommendations, quality workmanship, treating every home with respect, and supporting our employees as they develop their skills.

At Prado’s, you’re more than an employee; you’re part of a team helping build a company and reputation we can all be proud of.

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Champion
new_jobs.description:
**Location: Remote**

Greenback Expat Tax Services is a company that specializes in preparing tax returns for Americans living overseas. We are a highly energetic, positive, resourceful team working virtually across the globe. We believe that executional excellence is key to success. We are currently seeking a talented, passionate, enthusiastic Customer Success Champion to join our team. As a business, our DNA and core are about excellence in customer experience – we’re also in a big period of growth, so we see this role as one of the most integral ones on our team.

We believe that individuality brings great opportunities for us to grow and learn as a team but all of our successful teammates have these traits in common: passion, empathy, resourcefulness, high work ethic, the ability to openly communicate and receive feedback, and a thirst for learning!

**What to Expect**
------------------

We call this role a “customer champion” for a reason! Your role is to be the customer advocate and champion for our business.

* Addressing customer queries through our omni-channel platform and Zoom meetings
* Helping clients at every touchpoint in their journey with us – from first contact to closing out, you will be there to support them!
* Providing an all-star experience by not only being excellent at customer support, but also having a good working knowledge of US expat taxes (don’t worry, we’ll teach you!)
* Navigating our tools and platforms and becoming an expert in all of our processes.
* We’re a tax company, which means deadlines. You will need to work hard and be able to handle being under pressure during the tax season.
* We believe in high standards and no micromanagement – we provide the tools and resources to be successful and trust you to meet these standards.

We’re very proud of our company culture and we’re looking for someone who’s a great fit. We’re a small, tight-knit team – all of us working remotely from home offices. We’re obsessive about customer experience, believe that planning is the key to success, and like to work hard and make things happen-but also live our lives outside of the (home) office too! We’re looking for someone who is confident, reliable, an excellent communicator loves working in a fast-paced team, and is able to get things done with minimal supervision (we don’t like looking over your shoulder and don’t think you’d like that either).

**Key Skills Needed**
---------------------

* Excellent communication skills! You need to be able to read between the lines and craft messaging that is warm, friendly, professional and really meets the need of the specific demands of that interaction.
* The ability to convert warm leads at a high volume by setting proper expectations, providing thoughtful responses, and clearly outlining the next steps.
* Ability to identify opportunities to add value by monitoring industry changes, trends, and customer needs.
* Use analytics to manage and measure your success, know where to put additional effort, and prioritize. That means you need to be someone who can manage targets, metrics, and can analyze these metrics, understand what they mean, and make good decisions as a result.
* Excellence in execution: Attention to detail and ability to keep organized/juggle multiple things at once. We’re a seasonal business, so there are times when our inboxes are on fire! This is part of the role and being organized, handling stress well, and being able to juggle high-demand situations comes with the territory.
* We don’t expect you to be an accountant, but you will need to know the ins and outs US expat taxes – the enthusiasm to learn is key here!
* Bonus: current or former expat, or someone who appreciates or gets excited about the expat life.
* Time zone: we’re looking for someone who is in a fixed time zone. We’re not looking for long-term travelers/people who aren’t in the same time zone most of the year.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* The opportunity for you to work with highly talented, communicative, make-it-happen people who also love adventures.
* Very generous time-off policy.
* We have an excellent benefits package that is added on to your compensation for both US and non-US based team members.
* Annual team trip (2023: Mexico City, 2024: Costa Rica, 2025: Ireland, 2026: Morocco)!

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

* **Growth Potential:** We believe in nurturing talent from within. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to take on new challenges, develop your skills, and advance your career as we scale.
* **Small Team, Big Impact:** With a close-knit group, you’ll work directly with leadership, offering you a unique chance to shape the direction of our company and contribute meaningfully to our success.
* **Autonomy:** Employees are trusted with responsibility and given the freedom to make decisions where innovation and new ideas are welcomed and valued.

**Company Values**
------------------

* **Integrity Always**: We do the right thing even when no one is watching
* **Customer Commitment**: We take pride in consistently exceeding customer expectations
* **Team Mindset**: We collaborate and respect each other and acknowledge contributions
* **Daily Impact**: We act early, making data-driven decisions to achieve and surpass our goals
* **Empowered Performance**: We equip our team with the trust, resources, and independence needed for success
* **Grow Our Own**: We nurture and support our team’s abilities, goals, and learning
* **Transparent Talk**: We champion open and honest communication
